resolution: SCULPTSPLIT-0606, fully landed across three commits. (1) d454f7a34: the sculpt canvas became a fixed-palette MEASUREMENT surface (the addendum). (2) 462a43389 carried the first layout application (divider + the toolbar collision fix: chips + lens caption merged into ONE wrapping strip — nothing overlaps at any pane width; the clipped-sliver 3D pane died with the fixed-340 box). (3) 997fe9f36: the v2 design rulings — SCULPT is a VERTICAL STACK per the user's layout ruling (mesh full-width on top, one row below = unwrap canvas + toolset column), the divider drags the top/bottom split (twigged 'sculptSplitY', default 55/45, min heights keep both real), plus the three visual treatments: always-on faint cell lattice, mode-tinted brush footprint with mirror twin, and smart depth display (cell-bilinear smooth at rest, cell-snapped chunky while aiming). The shader half rode d597f379c via the shared index. Verify: characters 15/15 incl. the palette-contrast and data-contract pins; full cart bundles; the one standing RED remains the paint lane's cutout/models.test.ts WIP.
